title: The Holy Pascha
english: The sky is bright with the dance of the stars, but it is even brighter with the rising of the dawn-bringer; yet the present state of the night does not gleam so much for the stars as it now rejoices in the victory of our God and Savior, who says, 'Take courage, for I have overcome the world' (John 16:33).
With God overcoming the invisible enemy, we will also gain victory over the demons.
Let us remain with the saving cross, so that we may offer the first fruits of Jesus' gifts.
Let us celebrate this holy night with sacred services, singing a divine song and hymning a heavenly hymn.
Our Lord Jesus Christ, the sun of righteousness, has enlightened the present day and saved the faithful through the cross.
Let no one then disbelieve the symbols of the cross, but let him worship the blessed and thrice-blessed wood of the cross, which has opened the doors of heaven to us.

No longer 'do they light a lamp and put it under a basket' (Matthew 5:15), for I say the basket is the Law, but the lamp is the Word; for the Word was under the Law and was hidden to the unbelieving as if under a basket; but when he came upon the cross and was placed upon the lamp, then to the...
translator_notes: The Greek text begins and ends mid-sentence; the English reflects this with '...' and 'the...'.
